item.title: New Photo Of Mads Mikkelsen Mock-Choking A Fan During A Meet-And-Greet Goes Viral
item.description: Mads Mikkelsen Choking Fans refers to photographs of actor Mads Mikkelsen mock-choking his fans, his hands around their necks, during conventions and meet-and-greets.
